headline: Administration and Operations Manager
summary: Administration and operations manager with ten years in retail distribution and aquaculture. I run the administrative, facilities and support functions of a multi-branch company, write the policies and procedures behind them, and led our ISO 9001 certification. I manage a team of eight and control a multi-million peso operating budget.
highlights: Led ISO 9001:2015 certification for the head office and two warehouses, passed with no major findings.
Rewrote 30 administrative procedures as process maps, cutting purchase-request approval time from nine days to three.
Brought office and utilities spending 12% under budget two years in a row.
skills: Management system standards and internal audits

experience.title: Administration and Operations Manager
bullets: Head administration, facilities, fleet and document control for the head office and four sales branches.
Wrote the company's administrative policy manual, approved by the board in 2022.
Lead the internal audit programme for the quality management system and follow up corrective actions.

experience.title: Administrative Supervisor
bullets: Supervised six administrative and clerical staff supporting 11 delivery routes.
Introduced a controlled filing system for contracts, permits and vehicle papers.

education.credential: Bachelor of Science in Business Administration, major in Management
